items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I had Albert Jive on drums, D on trumpet, I'm on piano, just three pieces.

ctx.x: Who was with you at this place at St. Bernard and St. Claude?
Let me see. Who had one drum? Was it Albert Jive? Albert. Right. I had Albert Jive on drums, D on trumpet, I'm on piano, just three pieces.
And from there you went to Bunky?
